title: Source Event Envelope
description: One row per event from any data source. Pass-1 verbatim only — no reasoning fields. Every event must round-trip back to its source via raw_ref.

account_local_id.description: Identifier in the source system's primary-key space. Linking to canonical account_id happens in W2b.

date.description: ISO 8601. If the source only provides a date, use 00:00:00 UTC and note in provenance.

source.description: Source category. 'other' must include source_vendor in fields.

type.description: Source-native event type (e.g. 'Outbound', 'Inbound', 'Stage 3 - Select Vendor'). Verbatim from source.

subject.description: Short human-readable label. Verbatim where possible.

id.description: Source primary key — must round-trip to the source record

fields.description: Verbatim source fields preserved for provenance. No transformations.

source_value.description: Raw value(s) the row was derived from, truncated to 240 chars
